description: This Java class defines various enumerations and static methods for handling loan-related enumeration data within the Fineract project, including loan types, statuses, interest methods, repayment schedules, and other loan parameters.

classes.name: LoanEnumerations
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to retrieve enumeration data for various loan parameters and statuses within the Fineract loan module.

methods.name: loanEnumeration
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData object for a given enumeration type name and id.

methods.name: repaymentStartDateType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given RepaymentStartDateType enum or id.

methods.name: loanTermFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for loan term frequency type based on id or PeriodFrequencyType.

methods.name: termFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for term frequency type based on id or PeriodFrequencyType.

methods.name: repaymentFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for repayment frequency type based on id or PeriodFrequencyType.

methods.name: repaymentFrequencyNthDayType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for nth day type in repayment frequency schedule.

methods.name: repaymentFrequencyDayOfWeekType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for day of week type in repayment frequency schedule.

methods.name: interestRateFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for interest rate frequency type based on id or PeriodFrequencyType.

methods.name: amortizationType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for amortization method based on id or AmortizationMethod.

methods.name: interestType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for interest calculation method based on id or InterestMethod.

methods.name: interestCalculationPeriodType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for interest calculation period type based on id or InterestCalculationPeriodMethod.

methods.name: transactionType
methods.description: Returns LoanTransactionEnumData for a given transaction type id or LoanTransactionType.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given LoanStatusEnumData or LoanStatus.

methods.name: loanCycleValueConditionType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for loan cycle value condition type based on id or LoanProductValueConditionType.

methods.name: loanCycleParamType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for loan cycle parameter type based on id or LoanProductParamType.

methods.name: loanVariationType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for loan variation type based on id or LoanTermVariationType.

methods.name: interestRecalculationCompoundingType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for interest recalculation compounding type based on id or InterestRecalculationCompoundingMethod.

methods.name: interestRecalculationCompoundingNthDayType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for nth day type in interest recalculation compounding schedule.

methods.name: interestRecalculationCompoundingDayOfWeekType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for day of week in interest recalculation compounding schedule.

methods.name: rescheduleStrategyType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for reschedule strategy type based on id or LoanRescheduleStrategyMethod.

methods.name: interestRecalculationFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for interest recalculation frequency type based on id or RecalculationFrequencyType.

methods.name: preCloseInterestCalculationStrategy
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for pre-close interest calculation strategy based on id or LoanPreCloseInterestCalculationStrategy.
